Every number on this page is **measured** in this repository: it is read from `data/bundle.json`, which `experiments/export_explorer.py --team cursor` copies from the committed result files (`experiments/results/cursor_*.json`), the hypothesis register (`research/teams/cursor/hypotheses.json`) and the GPU ledger (`research/teams/cursor/compute-ledger.jsonl`). Nothing is recomputed except means and standard errors over seeds (sample standard deviation divided by √n). What the numbers mean, and which claims they support, is in the [report](../report/index.html) ([PDF](../report/index.pdf){download="milady-2027-cursor-report.pdf"}); the code, data and agent organisation are drawn in the [architecture](../diagrams/code-architecture.html), [workflow](../diagrams/experiment-workflow.html) and [roles](../diagrams/agent-organisation.html) diagrams.

[Loading `data/bundle.json`…]{#xp-loading .xp-note}

The five values stored in `experiments/results/cursor_metrics.json`, with the file each one comes from.

::: {#xp-kpis .xp-kpis}
:::

## Mechanisms compared {#compare}

Each row is one variant of one experiment, scored at the held-out value Rm = 12 by the same function. Choose a metric and either the mean over the seeds (dot: mean, bar: ± one standard error, grey dots: seeds) or one seed. The axis is logarithmic. The dashed line is the target used in the registered hypotheses for that metric (1.2 for the energy-distance ratio, 0.1 for C4), as stated in the report.

```{=html}
<div class="xp-controls">
  <label>Metric <select id="xp-metric"></select></label>
  <label>Seed <select id="xp-seed"><option value="mean">mean over seeds</option></select></label>
  <label>Experiments <select id="xp-family">
    <option value="all">all</option>
    <option value="learned">networks (sampling constraint, free, learned flow)</option>
    <option value="fourier">Fourier baselines (cutoff, midpoint)</option>
  </select></label>
</div>
<div class="xp-chart" id="xp-chart" role="img" aria-label="Chart of the chosen metric for each variant"></div>
<table class="xp tbl" id="xp-table"></table>
```

## Energy balance {#balance}

File `cursor_stationary.json`: residuals of the total and magnetic energy balance on the first and second halves of the dynamic window, per seed. The last row is the mean of the absolute values ± SE.

```{=html}
<table class="xp tbl" id="xp-balance"></table>
```

## Null counts {#nulls}

Relative error of the number of magnetic null points (trilinear count) against the reference field, per seed, for the truncations and midpoints of the `cursor_nulls*.json` files.

```{=html}
<div class="xp-chart" id="xp-nulls-chart" role="img" aria-label="Chart of the null-count errors"></div>
<table class="xp tbl" id="xp-nulls"></table>
```

## Hypothesis register {#register}

The register `research/teams/cursor/hypotheses.json`, with each hypothesis's statement and refutation criterion written before its computation. Filter by status or search the text; click an identifier for the criterion and the verdict.

```{=html}
<div class="xp-controls">
  <label>Status <select id="xp-hstatus"><option value="">all</option></select></label>
  <label>Search <input id="xp-hq" type="search" placeholder="e.g. midpoint, H16"></label>
  <span class="xp-note" id="xp-hcount"></span>
</div>
<table class="xp tbl" id="xp-hyp"></table>
```

## GPU jobs and costs {#gpu}

The finished jobs of `research/teams/cursor/compute-ledger.jsonl` (RunPod pods, one command each).

```{=html}
<div class="xp-kpis" id="xp-gpu-kpis"></div>
<div class="xp-controls">
  <label>Jobs <select id="xp-rc"><option value="">all</option><option value="0">exit code 0</option><option value="fail">failed</option></select></label>
</div>
<table class="xp tbl" id="xp-gpu"></table>
```
